now.title: Task 1: Natro paths and live tests
now.summary: The laptop is back online and working again. It added walking back to the hive from every field (17 return paths from Natro), plus a safety rule so Apex never presses reset keys or clicks unless the Bee Swarm screen is showing.

steps.title: Laptop set up and running Opus at medium effort
Shared task files, and path timing that follows your movespeed
Fix where Apex reads the pollen counter
steps.detail: The panel sat 20 px lower on the laptop, so Pine Tree looked like 0 out of 5 even though every trip landed. Fixed at 11:10 AM.

steps.title: Fix how Apex finds Natro's top bar (for speed buffs)
steps.detail: Found on 116 out of 116 saved screenshots. Fixed at 11:22 AM. Haste icons are still untested live.

steps.title: Test hive to the red cannon
steps.detail: Hive 3: 5/5, hive 4: 4/4, hive 5: 2/2, hive 6: 2/2. Hives 1 and 2 were taken on all 9 servers, so they're not tested yet.

steps.title: Test full trips to Pine Tree
steps.detail: 5 out of 5 today (hive 3): cannon, glide, sprinkler and gather check.

steps.title: Test the other fields
steps.detail: 42 out of 51 trips landed (hive 4). 13 fields are 3/3 or 2/3. Stump 1/3 (Stump Snail blocks the gather check), Coconut 1/3 and Pepper 0/3 were cut short by the battery popup.

steps.title: Return paths from each field back to the hive
steps.detail: 17 walk-back routes from Natro added at 1:02 PM, simplified at 1:37 PM. Being tested live now.

steps.title: Safety: only press keys when the game screen shows
steps.detail: Added at 1:19 PM after a test started on a non-game screen and blind key presses opened a Roblox settings page.

stages.title: Foundation and gather loop
stages.detail: Apex can gather one field and convert, on repeat. Merged into the main copy on Nov 11.

stages.title: Paths: Natro routes, return paths, your own hive slot
stages.detail: 46 Natro routes plus 17 walk-back-to-hive routes are in pull request #2 and being tested live.

stages.title: Gathering: proper convert, 12 patterns, 17 field settings
stages.detail: Convert at the hive with a Make Honey check, Natro's 12 gather patterns, and settings for all 17 fields.

stages.title: Overnight reliability
stages.detail: Recovery and a watchdog so it runs all night. First code is written (auto-rejoin, reset-loop guard, stall check) but not tested live yet.

stages.title: Extras: hotbar timers and Discord webhook
stages.detail: Use hotbar items on timers, and send status updates to your Discord.

stages.title: Tester build v0.1
stages.detail: The packaged app plus short tester notes. Estimate: about Nov 24 to Dec 1.

later: v0.2: Polar Bear quest. After that: free Red AI, boosts, planters, Mondo and Vicious, then launch (Discord, and Reddit only in the Advertising Megathread).

tests.name: Haste buff
tests.result: Read correctly in the live game (speed 31.9) during a cannon walk.

tests.name: Red cannon
tests.result: Hive 3: 5/5, hive 4: 4/4, hive 5: 2/2, hive 6: 2/2 today. Hives 1 and 2 not tested yet (always taken).

tests.name: Reliability
tests.result: Code and unit tests done. Not tested in the live game yet.

tests.name: Other fields
tests.result: 42/51 trips (hive 4). Mountain Top, Spider, Strawberry, Sunflower, Cactus, Bamboo, Dandelion, Clover, Pumpkin, Mushroom, Pineapple, Pine Tree 3/3; Blue Flower and Rose 2/3; Stump 1/3; Coconut 1/3 and Pepper 0/3 cut short by the battery popup.

tests_note: Live results come from the laptop, on your alt PenampungPett (movespeed 29).

needs_you.title: Keep the test laptop on the charger
needs_you.detail: It's back online. Set Windows Power options so it never sleeps or shows battery popups while plugged in.

needs_you.title: Add an auto-rejoin toggle to the Settings tab
needs_you.detail: The new auto-rejoin setting (on by default) only lives in settings.json right now. Your UI, so your call when.

needs_you.title: Re-pick the pollen bar fill colour on your PCs
needs_you.detail: On the laptop the bag colour isn't the default, so the bag percent can't be read. If the UI doesn't expose this, the laptop will make the bar find itself instead.
